name: riftwise
description: RiftWise (formerly RiftWatch): live League of Legends esports scores, stats hub, power rankings, all-time head-to-head and a 24/7 stream guide. Web app plus a small Windows app (Tauri + React).

paragraphs: Live League of Legends esports scores, schedules, official standings and all-time head-to-head records, in your browser or as a tiny Windows app. Built for fans who follow more than one league, and for viewers of the 24/7 classic-tournament Twitch stream.

RiftWise was called RiftWatch up to version 0.3.40. Old links (lolworlds.com/riftwatch, github.com/drmonocle/riftwatch) forward here, and installed copies update themselves to RiftWise. Since 0.6.0 the web version lives at riftwise.gg (lolworlds.com/riftwise links forward there).
